name: executive
title: Executive
description: A one-page brief and a decisions-needed list beside the standard project files.
audience: Brief and plain: lead with the decision or the status in one or two sentences, then risks and what is needed from me; no code or jargon unless asked.

farm_tasks.title: One-page brief draft
farm_tasks.does: Drafts a one-page brief: the decision or status first, then risks and what is needed.
farm_tasks.escalate: You read it first; Claude checks every number against its source before the brief is shared.

farm_tasks.title: Decisions needed
farm_tasks.does: Lists the decisions waiting on someone in the notes, with who and by when.
farm_tasks.escalate: A decision with no named owner is listed as unassigned; Claude reads the notes when a deadline is ambiguous.

farm_tasks.title: Weekly digest
farm_tasks.does: Summarises the week's project notes into a short digest, decisions first.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude checks any figure against its source before the digest is forwarded.

pane.label: Start my day
pane.prompt: Start my day: show what is waiting for me, what is overdue and what I should do first.

pane.label: Decisions needed
pane.prompt: Show the decisions that are waiting on me.

pane.label: One-page brief
pane.prompt: Write a one-page brief of where this project stands: outcome sought, status, cost and risks.

pane.label: What is waiting
pane.prompt: What handoffs and tasks are waiting for me?

pane.label: Note a decision
pane.prompt: Write down a decision. Ask me what was decided and why.

pane.label: Open a project
pane.prompt: Open a project for me. Ask me which one.

pane.label: Sort my inbox
pane.prompt: Review my inbox and file each item into the right project.

pane.label: Find in my notes
pane.prompt: Look something up in my notes. Ask me what I am looking for.

pane.label: What changed
pane.prompt: What has changed since I last looked?

pane.label: Add a task
pane.prompt: I want to add a task. Ask me what it is and which project it belongs to.

pane.label: Close a project
pane.prompt: Close out a project. Ask me which one.
